collection.description: A theatrical mask resembles a face from an old legend, worrying some spectators.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A theatrical mask resembles a face from an old legend, worrying some spectators.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Children learn it is a performance prop.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (villager) admits several versions of the legend exist.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Others miss the old mask and debate why.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (child), a frightened child, is allowed to leave.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (elder) recalls being scared by the same tale.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The performance ends without settling the legend.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (villager) claims the mask winked; nobody else saw it.
